statements.status_notes: Debian's security tracker records webkit2gtk in trixie as resolved at 2.54.0-1~deb13u1. WebKitGTK WSA-2026-0006 identifies 2.54.0 as the fixed release. Sources: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/data/json and https://webkitgtk.org/security/WSA-2026-0006.html. This statement applies only to the listed Debian binary packages at the exact version.
